findings.text: the crew tool's generic over-budget receipt proposes fields=["classification"], a runs-view field this new branch refuses by name, and its limit=10 does not reach a workable page on the pinned window either: the run's own rows give a default of 67,958 and 138,848 for a default-size page of 25 cells, so ten cells land near 96,000, still over the ceiling; the fields half is a pre-existing wart this view now makes reachable, it is recorded in the reviewed fragment itself, and reckon/mcp_budget.py is outside the reviewed node's write scope.

justifications.durability: the transport repair is guarded by a set-equality assertion on the default's key set (tests/test_crew_velocity_view.py:250-259), so reinstating the cells reddens it on any fixture, and the until exclusion has a fired negative control asserting 16 == 9; what keeps this off 20 is that no mutation of the withholding itself was fired, so the transport guard is read from the assertion rather than demonstrated red.
justifications.evidence: the repaired property is now measured two independent ways, an assertion against mcp_budget.DEFAULT_RESPONSE_CEILING (tests/test_crew_velocity_view.py:262-264) and the run's own serialised sizes over the real mounted checkout for both windows including the honest over-ceiling rows (80,308 and 138,848 in velocity-size-measurement.log), and I reproduced the two-day default exactly (29,383) and the paging path (58,147 at limit=10, next_cursor true); the pinned window's rows I read but did not re-run.
justifications.fit: the branch mirrors its neighbours' shape, refusals by name with the accepted set beside them (reckon/mcp.py:4005-4017), optional blocks gated by one module-level set (3753), cells paged through the shared paginate helper (4034); the evidence fragment carries the required meta and project-absolute figure src, the added test file follows the synthesised-repository idiom of tests/test_velocity.py, and no name the repository rules forbid appears in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every clause holds and the repaired one is reproduced independently (29,383 characters over the two-day window against the 80,000 ceiling, and the run's pinned-window row of 67,958 read from velocity-size-measurement.log), but the over-budget receipt this view can still produce advises fields=["classification"] (reckon/mcp_budget.py:105), a runs-view field the branch refuses by name (reckon/mcp.py:4005-4017), so that receipt's own narrowing advice costs the caller one refused request before the limit alone works.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status 348688e8..1a94f382 lists exactly the files under the five declared write paths and nothing else, reckon/cli.py stays with the peer the manifest names, the reviewed worktree is clean at 1a94f382 with no branch operation, and the diff's only label-scan hits are SVG hex colour literals, which the naming rules carve out.
